title: GHSL AI-agent index lists artifact metadata trust flaw in actions/attest
summary: The privileged commit-dist.yml trusted a branch name supplied by a fork-controlled artifact, allowing the workflow to commit attacker-controlled dist files to a repository branch under its write token.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index includes this advisory among findings discovered with AI agents. The individual advisory credits the human GHSL reporter and does not identify agent contributions; no item-level AI steps are described. Reported 2026-09-03 and fixed in PR #488 on 2026-09-14.
classification_note: The cited sources document the finding and remediation; they do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in PR #488 on 2026-09-14. The advisory notes current repository pull-request access is restricted to collaborators; external attack exposure depends on settings changing.

impacts.conditions: Attacker-controlled artifact metadata can select branch and content for a repository push.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
